intro: The New Testament begins with four Gospels, each telling the life of Jesus. Matthew is the first.
Written especially for Jewish readers, it shows Jesus as the promised king, fulfilling the Old Testament again and again.

Chapters one to four: his birth, and the start of his ministry. Chapters five to twenty-five: his teaching and miracles, including the Sermon on the Mount. Chapters twenty-six to twenty-eight: his death, his resurrection, and his last command to his followers.
Tradition holds that Matthew, a tax collector who became one of the twelve apostles, wrote it.
Listen for the phrase: that it might be fulfilled.
